fact: Minister Raafat Hindi told the Senate that the Egyptian Responsible AI Center was established in the communications ministry at the end of 2025 to support safe AI use in government bodies and develop regulatory models.
MP Sahar Albazar writes that Egypt's draft AI bill bans prohibited AI systems outright, requires prior approval for high-risk ones, and mandates algorithmic fairness, transparency and auditability.
MP Ahmed Badawi, chair of the House ICT committee, said an integrated AI bill is being prepared with the ministry, including mechanisms for crimes committed using AI; it is not yet published.

Al-Masry Al-Youm reports MP Amira Saber submitted a 24-article AI governance bill to the House of Representatives whose article 2 prohibits eight AI activities including deepfakes and AI used for bias, with penalties in articles 23-24.
